title: Before You Book Summer 2027
why: Warm leads and past guests planning next summer. Insider details that set honest expectations (cave access, shipwreck, half-day) and push early planning.
hook_options: What we'd tell a friend before they book summer 2027.
The tour page won't tell you this. Our guides will.
Planning Door County 2027? Read this first.
caption: Kayak tours are back in May 2027. Before you book: the lake decides cave entry each morning, the shipwreck tour stays on calm bay water, and warmest isn't the same as best. Save this for when you're picking dates. #DoorCounty #CavePoint #DeathsDoor #DoorCounty2027

slides.headline: What we'd tell a friend before booking.
slides.body: Kayak tours return May 2027. Here's what our guides know that the tour page doesn't spell out.

slides.headline: The lake decides cave entry, daily.
slides.body: Wind, waves, water level. Guides call it the morning of your tour. Most days, full access. Some days, the cliffs from outside.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/Amazing photos to brand/8CD7DE89-1F3D-4731-A7CA-54789C698CEA.jpg

slides.headline: 15 to 20 feet of visibility.
slides.body: On a good day you can see the lakebed from your seat. Most people don't expect that in the Midwest.

slides.headline: An 1888 schooner, about 12 feet down.
slides.body: The Fleetwing ran aground in Garrett Bay. On a calm day you trace her hull from your kayak. No clear-bottom boat needed.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/Bluff Shipwreck tours/DJI_0042.JPG

slides.headline: Nervous about open lake? Book the bay.
slides.body: The shipwreck tour stays on protected bayside water. Slower pace, more story. It's where we send nervous paddlers.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/Bluff Shipwreck tours/Door bluff shipwreck tour.jpg

slides.headline: Add a dunes hike and a light lunch.
slides.body: One guest's half-day: an hour-plus of paddling, a 30 to 40 minute walk to a dune lookout, lunch, then the paddle back.

slides.headline: There's a short ride to the launch.
slides.body: You check in, then hop a quick ride to the water. Our site lists it at about 5 minutes.

slides.headline: Warmest isn't the same as best.
slides.body: Late July and August have the warmest water. May, June, and September run quieter, with smaller groups and easier parking.

slides.headline: Caves: lake's call. Wreck: calm bay.
slides.body: Half-day for the hike. June or September if you hate crowds. That's the insider version.

slides.headline: Kayak tours are back May 2027.
slides.body: Plan it now at doorcountykayaktours.com. Tag the person you're bringing to Door County next summer.
